label: rare: step just after a short y..s run (early original phase or first copy step)
explanation: Very sparse (78 activations over 1M sequences), weak magnitude (max ~0.2). Fires only at t=3..6 in two contexts: (a) original phase, the step right after an early y-then-s run (e.g. y s s [X], y y s [X], with orig(1)=y); (b) the first copy step (recall_idx=1, input = orig(0) fed back) of short sequences (mostly L=3-4) whose last original token is s and whose orig(1) is often y (strongest: 3 y s <DEL> [3]). Never fires at t<3, on the delimiter, or late in the copy phase. Every predicate built on these cues has precision under ~7%: the feature picks out a narrow conjunction that the available variables cannot isolate. The best disjunction reaches about 45% recall at under 2% precision on dev. The magnitude ordering is not otherwise characterized.
